description: Source code implementing host mapping rules for URL rewriting, including classes and methods for adding, applying, and managing rules for hostname and port remapping within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: HostMappingRules
classes.description: Manages rules for hostname and port rewriting, including adding, applying, and setting rules from strings.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::MapRule
classes.description: Represents a hostname pattern and its replacement hostname and port for mapping rules.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::ExclusionRule
classes.description: Represents a hostname pattern to be excluded from rewriting.

methods.name: RewriteHost
methods.description: Attempts to rewrite the host and port of a given HostPortPair based on the rules.

methods.name: RewriteUrl
methods.description: Rewrites the URL's host and port according to the rules, updating the URL if a match is found.

methods.name: AddRuleFromString
methods.description: Parses a rule string to add either an exclusion or mapping rule.

methods.name: SetRulesFromString
methods.description: Sets multiple rules from a comma-separated string, clearing existing rules.
